servers.name: openalex-research
servers.description: OpenAlex MCP server for broad scholarly search, citation analysis, expert mapping, research trends, and geographic literature analysis.

tools.name: search_works
tools.description: Search scholarly works with venue, institution, year, and citation filters.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: Retrieve full metadata for a specific work.

tools.name: get_related_works
tools.description: Find similar papers based on citation and topic signals.

tools.name: get_work_citations
tools.description: Analyze forward citations for a work.

tools.name: get_work_references
tools.description: Inspect backward references for a work.

tools.name: search_authors_by_expertise
tools.description: Find leading researchers in a topic.

tools.name: find_review_articles
tools.description: Identify review papers and meta-analyses.

tools.name: find_seminal_papers
tools.description: Find foundational, high-impact papers in a field.

tools.name: analyze_topic_trends
tools.description: Track publication trends over time.

tools.name: analyze_geographic_distribution
tools.description: Map research activity by geography.

tools.name: find_open_access_version
tools.description: Find open-access versions or PDF links for a paper.

servers.name: ncbi-datasets
servers.description: Unofficial NCBI Datasets MCP server for taxonomy, genomes, genes, assemblies, comparative genomics, and phylogenetic metadata.

tools.name: search_taxonomy
tools.description: Search taxonomic information by organism name.

tools.name: get_taxonomy_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed taxonomy and lineage information.

tools.name: get_taxonomic_lineage
tools.description: Return complete lineage for a taxon.

tools.name: get_organism_info
tools.description: Inspect organism-level data and associated datasets.

tools.name: search_genomes
tools.description: Search genomes by organism or criteria.

tools.name: search_assemblies
tools.description: Search assembly records with detailed filtering.

tools.name: search_genes
tools.description: Search genes by symbol, organism, or location.

tools.name: get_genome_annotation
tools.description: Retrieve annotation information for an assembly.

tools.name: find_orthologs
tools.description: Find orthologous genes across organisms.

tools.name: compare_genomes
tools.description: Compare multiple genome assemblies.

tools.name: blast_search
tools.description: Run BLAST-style sequence similarity search against NCBI-backed resources.

tools.name: get_phylogenetic_tree
tools.description: Retrieve phylogenetic tree data for organisms.

servers.name: bio-blast
servers.description: Bio-MCP BLAST server for nucleotide and protein similarity search, custom BLAST databases, and async queue workflows.

tools.name: blastn
tools.description: Run nucleotide-nucleotide BLAST searches.

tools.name: blastp
tools.description: Run protein-protein BLAST searches.

tools.name: makeblastdb
tools.description: Build a custom BLAST database from FASTA input.

tools.name: blastn_async
tools.description: Submit long-running nucleotide searches to a queue.

tools.name: blastp_async
tools.description: Submit long-running protein searches to a queue.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the status of an async BLAST job.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Retrieve the result of a completed async BLAST job.

servers.name: pubchem
servers.description: Unofficial PubChem MCP server for chemical search, molecular properties, safety, toxicity, regulatory context, and environmental fate analysis.

tools.name: search_compounds
tools.description: Search compounds by name, formula, identifier, or CAS number.

tools.name: get_compound_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed compound metadata by CID.

tools.name: get_compound_properties
tools.description: Inspect molecular weight, logP, TPSA, and related descriptors.

tools.name: search_similar_compounds
tools.description: Find structurally similar compounds.

tools.name: search_bioassays
tools.description: Search biological assays relevant to a compound or target.

tools.name: get_safety_data
tools.description: Retrieve hazard classifications and safety data.

tools.name: get_toxicity_info
tools.description: Inspect toxicity and risk information.

tools.name: assess_environmental_fate
tools.description: Review environmental fate and biodegradation signals.

tools.name: get_regulatory_info
tools.description: Inspect regulatory information linked to the compound.

tools.name: get_literature_references
tools.description: Retrieve literature references connected to a compound.
